title: Born from Stone
lines: On the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, a boulder sat upon the peak. This stone measured exactly thirty-six feet and five inches in height — one inch for each of the three hundred sixty-five degrees of the celestial sphere, and twenty-four feet in circumference — one foot for each period of the solar calendar.

Since the world's creation, this stone had received the truth of Heaven and the beauty of Earth, the essence of the sun and the elegance of the moon. One day, it cracked open with a sound that shook the oceans, and a stone egg rolled forth.

The wind caught the egg and carried it. Where it landed, it hatched not into a bird or beast, but into a stone monkey with eyes that blazed with light. The Jade Emperor himself noticed the disturbance and sent scouts to investigate.
From his first breath, the Stone Monkey was destined for greatness — or for destruction. The universe had created something it could not easily control.
